name: kyc-additional-document-required
subject: We need more information to confirm your identity
previewText: Please submit the requested additional information so we can verify your identity

fields.heading: Identity check - additional information required
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

We have been unable to verify your identity with the information that you provided for your Abundance account.This may be for a number of reasons:

fields.items:
You live overseas
You are not registered on the electoral roll
You have recently moved house
Your house is a new build or part of an apartment block

fields.body: Before you can invest, we need you to submit a proof of address document to confirm your identity.
